title: ReelRetain AI model evaluation
data_disclaimer: Evaluation uses synthetic inputs and synthetic targets only; it does not represent validation on genuine Instagram or other audience analytics.

excluded_columns.hook_time_sec: Not reliably measured by the current video extractor.
excluded_columns.face_presence: Face detection is not implemented in the video extractor.
excluded_columns.is_synthetic: Synthetic-data provenance flag; constant in this dataset and not a video feature.
excluded_columns.video_format: Dataset labels content styles (for example, voiceover); the extractor does not classify them.
excluded_columns.posting_dayofweek_utc: Posting schedule metadata is not available from a video upload.
excluded_columns.topic_niche: Semantic content category is not inferred from the upload.
excluded_columns.speech_rate_wpm: Not extracted from uploaded videos because speech transcription is not performed.
excluded_columns.posting_hour_utc: Posting schedule metadata is not available from a video upload.
excluded_columns.watched_percentage_synthetic: Prediction target; excluded from all model inputs.
excluded_columns.average_watch_time_sec_synthetic: Prediction target; excluded from all model inputs.
excluded_columns.early_dropoff_rate_pct_synthetic: Prediction target; excluded from all model inputs.

selection_procedure: For each target, select the candidate with the lowest validation MAE. Refit that pipeline on training plus validation rows, then report final metrics on the untouched test split.

watched_percentage_synthetic.definition: Synthetic percentage of a video's duration watched.

average_watch_time_sec_synthetic.definition: Synthetic average watch time in seconds.

early_dropoff_rate_pct_synthetic.definition: Synthetic percentage of viewers dropping off early.

limitations: All target values and input features are synthetic; metrics do not validate real audience behavior.
Synthetic feature distributions and semantics may differ from features extracted from real uploads.
The held-out test set is synthetic and cannot establish real-world predictive validity.
Display estimates are clipped to physical presentation ranges; clipping does not make them measured facts.
domain_mismatch: The dataset features are synthetic and may not share distributions or semantics with measured uploads. In particular, scene_changes and motion_intensity use a sampled-frame approximation, and audio_energy uses decoded-audio RMS. Unavailable audio values at inference are imputed using training medians.
